description: High-risk, life-threatening drug-drug interaction invariant rules

rules.message: High-risk bleeding interaction: Concurrent prescription of warfarin with systemic NSAIDs or high-dose aspirin causes marked platelet dysfunction and gastric mucosal ulceration, dramatically increasing major GI haemorrhage risk.

provenance.source: CHEST Guideline: Antithrombotic Therapy and Prevention of Thrombosis
citations: Holbrook A, et al. Evidence-based management of anticoagulant therapy: Antithrombotic Therapy and Prevention of Thrombosis. CHEST. 2012;141(2 Suppl):e152S-e184S.

rules.message: Hyperkalemia synergism: Co-administration of ACE inhibitors or ARBs with potassium-sparing aldosterone antagonists risks severe, asymptomatic hyperkalemia and fatal cardiac dysrhythmia without serial potassium monitoring.

provenance.source: AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure
citations: Heidenreich PA, et al. 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure. Circulation. 2022;145:e895-e1032.

rules.message: Pharmacokinetic activation blockade: Omeprazole and esomeprazole competitively inhibit hepatic CYP2C19 bioactivation of clopidogrel, significantly diminishing platelet inhibition and raising ischemic stent thrombosis risk.

citations: FDA Drug Safety Communication: Updated information on the interaction between clopidogrel and omeprazole (November 2009).

rules.message: Methotrexate clearance inhibition: NSAIDs reduce renal clearance of methotrexate via competitive inhibition of organic anion transporters, provoking severe bone marrow suppression and pancytopenia.

provenance.source: American College of Rheumatology (ACR) Guideline for Rheumatoid Arthritis
citations: Fraenkel L, et al. 2021 American College of Rheumatology Guideline for the Treatment of Rheumatoid Arthritis. Arthritis Rheumatol. 2021;73(7):1108-1123.
